source_lines_after.39: [F2] $L_\zeta=A+\zeta T$, where $T$ is middle multiplication by $\rho$; these operators commute and are symmetric. The rank-one relation is $r c_{\mathrm{id}}=c_{\mathrm{id}}s(r)+\partial_s(r)c_s$, while $r c_s=c_s r$. Thus after right reduction $T\beta(b)=0$, but $T\alpha(b)$ need not vanish ([[def-the-deformed-lefschetz-operator-on-b-x-b-s]], [[def-invariant-intersection-form-on-a-bott-samelson-bimodule]]).
